newsitem.title: UK: AA cargo and AEI in global link-up.
newsitem.headline: AA cargo and AEI in global link-up.

text.p: American Airlines Cargo announced on Tuesday a global partnership with U.S. based international logistics provider Air Express International (AEI).

Under the deal, AA Cargo will provide special pricing, space allocation, automation, handling considerations and dedicated personnel to AEI on a worldwide basis in exchange for designation as AEI's preferred carrier.

"Our companies already had a close partnership, with over $35 million in joint revenues in 1996. By affirming and formalising our commitment to each other, we are taking this long-standing relationship to the next level," said American Airlines Cargo President Dave Brooks. "We have completed our second annual joint Global Managers' Meeting and are very excited about the future.

Said Giorgio Laccona, vice president and general manager North America, for AEI: "We have strengthened our bond with American. This new partnership will allow AEI to expand and grow, while ensuring the highest quality global service to our customers."
With a network of alliances and interline partners, AA Cargo is able to move more than 4.5 million pounds (9.9 million kg) of cargo daily.
